To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) storage can be a profitable investment, (ii) the optimal storage policy has a dual threshold form, (iii) the optimal storage size is proportional to the variance in the net demand, and (iv) the optimal size of storage is insensitive to changes in the price and demand.

the optimal management policy has a dual-threshold structure, that the optimal storage is a profitable asset if the amortized investment cost is less than 25% of the constant price, and that the optimal size and value of storage decrease as the constant price increases.

the optimal energy storage size is less than one-fourth of the total electricity used in a day, and that the optimal management policy has dual thresholds, with one threshold being the optimal storage size.
